shapeSummary: Only the largest compound spur gear from the kit is modeled: a 48-tooth, 40 mm OD gear 6 mm thick with a coaxial 16-tooth, 14 mm OD pinion 10 mm tall, for 16 mm total height. A 4 mm through bore runs along Z. The gear axis is parallel to Z and passes through X=0, Y=20. The part spans Y 0 to 40 and Z -8 to 8, matching the bounds.
warnings: Dimensions are unverified estimates. The listing gives no sizes, so the bounds come from the image analysis.
Tooth counts, module, and the gear and pinion thicknesses are assumed. Teeth are simple trapezoids, not true involute profiles.
Only the largest gear is modeled. The other three gears, the pressed-in bearing, the two steel shafts and the two bronze bushings are omitted.
The 4 mm bore is an assumed value, with no bearing or bushing detail.
The gear axis is along Z as in the analysis, so the Y=0 bottom rule puts the gear center at Y=20.
